premises.name: ContinuousLinearMap.isCompact_image_coe_closedBall
premises.type: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {𝕜₂ : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} {F : Type u_4} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜₂] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedSpace 𝕜₂ F] {σ₁₂ : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜₂} [RingHomIsometric σ₁₂] [ProperSpace F] (f₀ : E →SL[σ₁₂] F) (r : ℝ) : IsCompact (DFunLike.coe '' Metric.closedBall f₀ r)
premises.doc:
**Banach-Alaoglu** theorem. The set of functions `f : E → F` that represent continuous linear
maps `f : E →SL[σ₁₂] F` at distance `≤ r` from `f₀ : E →SL[σ₁₂] F` is compact in the topology of
pointwise convergence. Other versions of this theorem can be found in
`Analysis.Normed.Module.WeakDual`.

premises.name: ContinuousLinearMap.isCompact_image_coe_of_bounded_of_closed_image
premises.type: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {𝕜₂ : Type u_2} {F : Type u_4} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜₂] [NormedSpace 𝕜₂ F] {σ₁₂ : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜₂} {E' : Type u_5} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'] [RingHomIsometric σ₁₂] [ProperSpace F] {s : Set (E' →SL[σ₁₂] F)} (hb : Bornology.IsBounded s) (hc : IsClosed (DFunLike.coe '' s)) : IsCompact (DFunLike.coe '' s)
premises.doc:
Let `s` be a bounded set in the space of continuous (semi)linear maps `E →SL[σ] F` taking values
in a proper space. If `s` interpreted as a set in the space of maps `E → F` with topology of
pointwise convergence is closed, then it is compact.

TODO: reformulate this in terms of a type synonym with the right topology.

premises.name: ContinuousLinearMap.isCompact_image_coe_of_bounded_of_weak_closed
premises.type: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {𝕜₂ : Type u_2} {F : Type u_4} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜₂] [NormedSpace 𝕜₂ F] {σ₁₂ : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜₂} {E' : Type u_5} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'] [RingHomIsometric σ₁₂] [ProperSpace F] {s : Set (E' →SL[σ₁₂] F)} (hb : Bornology.IsBounded s) (hc : ∀ (f : E' →SL[σ₁₂] F), ⇑f ∈ closure (DFunLike.coe '' s) → f ∈ s) : IsCompact (DFunLike.coe '' s)
premises.doc:
If a set `s` of semilinear functions is bounded and is closed in the weak-\* topology, then its
image under coercion to functions `E → F` is a compact set. We don't have a name for `E →SL[σ] F`
with weak-\* topology in `mathlib`, so we use an equivalent condition (see `isClosed_induced_iff'`).

premises.name: TopologicalSpace.coinduced
premises.type: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} (f : X → Y) (t : TopologicalSpace X) : TopologicalSpace Y
premises.doc:
Given `f : X → Y` and a topology on `X`,
the coinduced topology on `Y` is defined such that
`s : Set Y` is open if the preimage of `s` is open.
This is the finest topology that makes `f` continuous.

premises.name: TopologicalSpace.induced
premises.type: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} (f : X → Y) (t : TopologicalSpace Y) : TopologicalSpace X
premises.doc:
Given `f : X → Y` and a topology on `Y`,
the induced topology on `X` is the collection of sets
that are preimages of some open set in `Y`.
This is the coarsest topology that makes `f` continuous.
